name: Cloth Robes
description: Simple woven garments offering minimal protection.

name: Padded Armor
description: Quilted layers of cloth stuffed with wool or scrap.

name: Leather Jerkin
description: Hardened leather chestpiece, light and flexible.

name: Studded Leather
description: Leather armor reinforced with close-set metal studs.

name: Hide Armor
description: Crude armor made from thick animal hides.

name: Chain Shirt
description: A shirt made of interlocking metal rings.

name: Scale Mail
description: A coat and leggings covered with overlapping metal scales.

name: Breastplate
description: A solid metal plate that protects the front of the torso.

name: Half Plate
description: A combination of plate and chain, covering most of the body.

name: Full Plate
description: A complete suit of interlocking metal plates.

name: Ring Mail
description: Leather armor with metal rings sewn into it.

name: Splint Mail
description: Armor made of narrow vertical strips of metal riveted to a leather backing.

name: Banded Mail
description: Overlapping horizontal bands of steel laminated to leather.

name: Mithril Chain Shirt
description: A shirt of incredibly light and strong mithril rings.

name: Mithril Breastplate
description: A breastplate of shimmering mithril, strong as steel but feather-light.

name: Mithril Full Plate
description: A masterpiece of smithing, offering incredible protection with minimal weight.

name: Shield, Buckler
description: A small, fist-gripped shield for parrying.

name: Shield, Light Steel
description: A round or kite shield made of steel, offering good protection.

name: Shield, Tower
description: A massive shield that can provide cover.

name: Helmet, Open
description: A simple metal cap that protects the top of the head.

name: Helmet, Great Helm
description: A full helmet enclosing the entire head, with a narrow visor.

name: Gauntlets, Leather
description: Reinforced leather gloves.

name: Gauntlets, Plate
description: Metallic gloves with articulated plates.

name: Greaves
description: Plate armor designed to protect the shins.

name: Pauldrons
description: Armor plates that protect the shoulders.

name: Mask of the Silent
description: A magically silenced mask that muffles the wearer's breath and speech.

name: Spider Silk Cloak
description: A cloak woven from the silk of giant phase spiders, offering surprising resistance.

name: Wyvern Hide Vest
description: Tough leather from a wyvern, resistant to piercing attacks.

name: Boneweave Armor
description: Armor crafted from the bones and sinews of monstrous creatures.

name: Dragonscale Mail
description: Legendary armor crafted from the scales of an ancient dragon. Resists the dragon's element.

name: Glimmerwood Shield
description: A shield made from wood that absorbs magic, granting resistance to spells.

name: Obsidian Plate
description: Brittle but incredibly hard armor formed from volcanic glass. Weak to bludgeoning.

name: Crystal Shard Armor
description: Armor made from living crystal that can refract light-based attacks.

name: Dwarven Stoneplate
description: Extremely heavy armor carved from a single block of enchanted mountain granite.

name: Elven Leafweave
description: Armor that seems grown rather than made, offering stealth and protection.

name: Brigandine
description: Cloth or leather armor with steel plates riveted to the inside.

name: Cuirass
description: A breastplate and backplate fastened together.

name: Gorget
description: A steel collar to protect the neck.

name: Vambraces
description: Forearm guards.

name: Chausses
description: Plate armor for the legs.

name: Sabatons
description: Armored shoes covering the top of the foot.

name: Shadow Drapery
description: A cloak woven from tangible shadows, granting near-invisibility in darkness.

name: Celestial Aegis
description: A brilliant breastplate forged from a fallen star, radiating holy power.

name: Abyssal Carapace
description: Armor fashioned from the chitinous plates of a demon, resistant to fire and fear.

name: Living Ivy Wrap
description: Constantly growing ivy that hardens on impact. Regenerates over time.

name: Frostfell Mantle
description: A mantle of ice that never melts, granting immunity to cold and vulnerability to fire.

name: Molten Core Harness
description: Harness of cooled volcanic rock, glowing with internal heat. Immune to fire.

name: Puzzleplate
description: Armor made of interlocking adamantine plates that can be rearranged for different defenses.

name: Whisperweave Garb
description: Armor that allows the wearer to briefly become ethereal.

name: Trollhide Jerkin
description: Tough hide that slowly knits itself back together when damaged.

name: Gorgon Hide Shield
description: A heavy shield that can temporarily petrify attackers who strike it.

name: Stormrider's Cuirass
description: Armor that crackles with lightning, shocking nearby foes.

name: Lichebone Armor
description: Bone armor from a powerful lich, granting resistance to necrotic energy.

name: Kraken Leather
description: Slick, water-resistant leather that grants freedom of movement underwater.

name: Sunforged Plate
description: Plate armor blessed by a sun god, dealing radiant damage to undead attackers.

name: Runic Warding Bands
description: Bracelets etched with runes that can absorb a magical attack before shattering.

name: Doomplate
description: Armor forged in the heart of a dying star. Exudes an aura of dread.

name: Phoenix Down Cloak
description: A cloak that allows the wearer to rise from death once, consumed in the process.

name: Mage's Aetherial Robes
description: Robes that enhance magical power but offer little physical protection.

name: Sentinel's Ward
description: An amulet that creates a temporary forcefield against projectiles.

name: Platemail of the Juggernaut
description: Extremely heavy armor that allows the wearer to crash through obstacles.

name: Ghostwalker's Shroud
description: A shroud that allows the wearer to pass through solid objects for a short time.

name: Serpent Scale Armor
description: Scaly armor that grants resistance to poison.

name: Barbarian's Hide
description: A simple, rugged hide favored by northern tribes.

name: Assassin's Guild Leathers
description: Supple, silent leather armor with hidden pockets for tools.

name: Knight's Tabard
description: A cloth surcoat worn over armor, displaying a knight's heraldry.

name: Warlock's Cryptarmor
description: Armor fused from the remains of a patron's previous champions.

name: Dragonbone Mail
description: Armor crafted from the bones of a dragon, humming with residual power.

name: Final Bastion
description: The ultimate armor, said to be worn by the gods themselves. Nearly impenetrable.
